name: Leica SL2

rows.label: 缓存

rows.label: 色彩深度

rows.label: 色彩空间

rows.value: Leica L 卡口，带镜头与机身通信触点

rows.label: 防抖
rows.value: 5 轴机身防抖，最高补偿 5.5 挡
rows.originalValue: 5 axis Body Image Stabilization. Camera stabilizes up to 5.5 stops

rows.label: 对焦模式
rows.value: 自动对焦（iAF／AFs／AFc／触摸 AF）或手动对焦；手动时可选自动放大和峰值辅助
rows.originalValue: Automatic (Autofocus in modes iAF/AFs/AFc/Touch AF) or manual. With manual setting: Auto Magnification and Focus Peaking optionally available as focus aids

rows.label: 自动对焦系统
rows.value: 反差检测与深度映射
rows.originalValue: Based on contrast metering and depth mapping

rows.label: 自动对焦模式
rows.value: 智能 AF（自动选择 AFs／AFc）；AFs（合焦后拍摄）、AFc（可随时拍摄）；可保存 AF 设置
rows.originalValue: Smart AF (autonomously selects AFs and AFc), AFs (picture taken only after successful focusing), AFc (picture can be taken at any time), AF setting can be saved

rows.label: 自动对焦测量方式
rows.value: 点（可移动）、区域（可移动）、多区、分区、人脸检测、主体追踪；可选触摸 AF
rows.originalValue: Spot (can be shifted), Field (can be shifted), Multi-Field, Zone, Face detection, object Tracking, optional Touch AF

rows.label: 电子取景器
rows.value: 576 万点，120 帧/秒，0.78×，4:3，视野 100%；眼点 21 mm，屈光度 −4 至 +2；眼传感器自动切换取景器和液晶屏，延迟 0.005 秒
rows.originalValue: Resolution: 5,760,000 点, 120 fps, magnification: 0.78x, aspect ratio: 4:3, frame coverage: 100%, exit pupil position: 21 mm, setting range +2/-4 diopters, with eye sensor for automatic switchover between viewfinder and LCD panel, time delay 0.005 s

rows.label: 液晶显示屏
rows.value: 3.2 英寸 LED 背光液晶触摸屏；防指纹及防刮涂层；210 万点，3:2
rows.originalValue: 3.2“ (backlight LED) with anti-fingerprint and anti-scratch coating, 2,100,000 像素 (点), format 3:2, touch control available

rows.label: 机顶显示屏
rows.value: 1.28 英寸高反射半透式单色液晶屏，128×128 像素；可视角 120°，防指纹涂层
rows.originalValue: 1.28“ highly reflective trans-reflective monochrome LCD, 128 x 128 像素, viewing angle 120°; anti-fingerprint coating

rows.label: 测光
rows.value: TTL 通过镜头测光
rows.originalValue: TTL (‚Through The Lens‘ exposure metering)

rows.label: 曝光模式

rows.originalValue: Automatic program (P), Aperture priority (A): manual aperture setting, Shutter priority mode (S): manual shutter speed setting Manual (M): manual setting for shutter speed and aperture

rows.value: ±3 EV，1/3 或 1/2 EV 步长
rows.originalValue: ±3 EV in 1⁄3 EV increments or 1/2 EV increments

rows.originalValue: Auto ISO: ISO 100 to ISO 50000, Manual: ISO 50 to ISO 50000

rows.label: 白平衡

rows.originalValue: Automatic (Auto), Daylight 5200 K, Cloudy 6000 K, Shadow 7000 K, Tungsten 3200 K, HMI 5600 K, Fluorescent Warm 4000 K, Fluorescent Cold 4500 K, Flash 5400 K, Gray Card Live View, Gray Card, Color Temperature 2000 K to 11500 K

rows.value: 中央重点 TTL 预闪测光；支持 Leica SF 26／40／58／60／64 或系统兼容闪光灯；支持 SF C1 遥控
rows.originalValue: Using center-weighted TTL pre-flash metering with Leica flash units (SF 26, 40, 58, 60, 64) or with system-compatible flash units, flash remote control SF C1

rows.label: 闪光曝光补偿
rows.value: SF 40：±2 EV，1/2 EV 步长；SF 60：±2 EV，1/3 EV 步长
rows.originalValue: SF 40: ±2 EV in 1⁄2 EV increments, SF 60: ±2 EV in 1⁄3 EV increments

rows.label: 快门类型

rows.originalValue: Electronically controlled focal plane shutter/electronic shutter

rows.value: 机械快门 30 分钟–1/8000 秒；电子快门 1–1/40000 秒；闪光同步最高 1/250 秒
rows.originalValue: Mech. shutter: 30 min to 1⁄8000 s / Electr. shutter function: 1 s to 1⁄40000 s / Flash Synch: up to 1/250 s

rows.originalValue: Two-stage (1st stage: Activation of the camera electronics including autofocus and exposure metering, 2nd stage: Taking the picture)

rows.label: 自动包围曝光
rows.value: 3 或 5 张，最高 ±3 EV，1/3 EV 步长；偏移功能最高 ±3 EV
rows.originalValue: 3 or 5 exposures, up to ±3 EV, in 1⁄3 EV increments Shift function: up to ±3 EV

rows.label: 闪光灯连接
rows.value: 通过热靴连接
rows.originalValue: About the accessory shoe

rows.label: 闪光同步速度
rows.value: 1/250 秒，可用更慢快门；兼容 HSS 的 Leica 闪光灯在快于同步速度时自动切换 TTL 线性闪光
rows.originalValue: : 1⁄250 s, slower shutter speeds available, automatic changeover to TTL linear flash mode with HSS-compatible Leica flash units if sync time is undercut
